method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: get_rates
tools.title: Get exchange rates
tools.description: Latest or a single day's exchange rates. The raw-rate companion to `convert`. With `provider`, published rates from one or more institutions: on its own base the digits are as published, with the date they took effect.

date.description: Single day YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest rates.

quotes.description: ISO 4217 quote codes to return; omit for all.

provider.description: Provider key or keys, e.g. ECB or ['ECB', 'HMRC']. Serves published rates instead of the blend; a date inside a monthly or quarterly provider's period returns the rate in force. Keys at https://frankfurter.dev/providers/.

providers.description: Alias for `provider` accepting multiple provider keys.

tools.name: convert
tools.title: Convert currency
tools.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another. Returns {amount, currency} rounded to the target's minor units. Upstream rounds rates per direction; for low-value sources, flip via `get_rates` for more precision. Pass `provider` to use one institution's published rate, e.g. UST for a U.S. Treasury reporting rate.

amount.description: Amount in the source currency. Normalize localized input first: '100,50' -> 100.5; German '1.000,50' -> 1000.5; English '1,000.50' -> 1000.5.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD for a past rate; omit for latest.

provider.description: Provider key, e.g. ECB for European Central Bank or UST for U.S. Treasury reporting rates. Serves that institution's published rates instead of the blend; a date inside a monthly or quarterly provider's period returns the rate in force. Keys at https://frankfurter.dev/providers/.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.title: List currencies
tools.description: List all supported ISO 4217 currency codes and their full names (e.g. { 'USD': 'United States Dollar' }).

tools.name: list_providers
tools.title: List providers
tools.description: List the institutions whose rates Frankfurter relays, with key, rate type, frequency (daily, monthly or quarterly) and coverage dates. Use a key as `provider` in `convert` or `get_rates` for that institution's published rates instead of the blend.
